title: Reproducible cross-model benchmark for Muse Spark 1.1 evaluation
description: Build a bounded Meta Model API adapter and a reproducible cross-model benchmark packet to evaluate whether Muse Spark 1.1 should be promoted, bounded, or rejected, based on correctness, cost, safety, latency, reliability, and governance criteria.
pain_point: No existing systematic, reproducible evaluation framework for new model candidates; reliance on vendor claims without verified benchmarks; risk of silent fallback or unauthorized route changes without passing correctness, safety, and cost gates; need to separate vendor-announced capability from third-party evaluation and locally observed results.
use_case: Technical team needs to evaluate Muse Spark 1.1 for inclusion in the HUMMBL/Ownward model-routing stack by building a provider adapter and executing benchmark tasks across MCP reliability, governed delegation, repository execution, long-context integrity, computer-use safety, and cost-adjusted correctness, with the goal of reaching a terminal disposition (REJECTED, BOUNDED_USE, or PROMOTED_WITH_SCOPE) based on reproducible evidence.

title: Prevent truncation of latest notes for AI tool reading
description: Users need a system to manage HVAC review notes such that the latest exact note text is always short enough for ChatGPT/Codex to read fully, with automatic rotation to a fresh inbox when notes grow too long to avoid truncation.
pain_point: When the inbox grows too long, notes start truncating, causing ChatGPT/Codex to miss part of the latest note text, which can lead to incomplete or incorrect actions.
use_case: When processing HVAC review notes, the user (or an agent) must ensure ChatGPT/Codex can read the exact latest note text together with page label, route, URL, viewport, user agent, priority, kind, and visible context. If the inbox grows too long and starts truncating, a fresh exact-latest inbox is rotated before asking for more review.

title: First-party way to view generated PDF artifacts in sandbox
description: The user needs a built-in command or viewer to visually inspect generated PDF (and other document) artifacts directly within the sandbox platform, without having to manually rasterize them to images and read each PNG.
pain_point: No first-party way to look at a generated PDF; the agent had to hand-roll a second sandbox invocation to rasterize pages, then repeat the rasterize-and-Read cycle after fixing the chart, wasting time and sandbox round-trips.
use_case: Running a one-off data task (CSV in, PDF report out) through `gipity sandbox run`; the agent needs to visually confirm the PDF layout before calling the task done, but has to manually rasterize the PDF to PNGs using `pdftoppm -png -r 90` and then `Read` each PNG, repeating the cycle after each fix.

use_case: 每次队列执行后自动生成摘要评论并推送通知给Alex

title: Deterministic game loop stepping for verification
description: When verifying a real-time canvas/physics/animation game (e.g., Phaser brick-breaker), the agent attempts to verify gameplay via `gipity page eval` with wall-clock waits. The platform warns that real-time waiting leads to false negatives and recommends stepping the app's own loop deterministically, but provides no tool or mechanism to do so. The agent is forced to abandon real-time verification and ship the game with core mechanics (collision, scoring, lives, win/lose transitions) untested.
pain_point: The platform warns the agent to 'step the app's own loop deterministically' but nothing in the CLI or skills gives the agent a way to step a running game loop. The agent had no follow-up move: it dropped real-time verification entirely, shipped the game with its core mechanic (brick collision -> score -> win/lose transitions) never exercised.
use_case: Agent built a Phaser brick-breaker game and tried to verify the real gameplay loop (ball bounces, bricks break, score increments, lives decrement) by driving the deployed page with `gipity page eval`. First two evals worked; third eval returned warning about 14.5 fps and recommended stepping deterministically. Agent had no way to step the loop and abandoned verification, taking only a static screenshot.

title: WhatsApp Business API Integration for Unified Inbox
description: Integrate WhatsApp Business API into OHC so that owners can send and receive WhatsApp messages directly within the OHC unified feed, eliminating the need to switch between apps and ensuring all customer interactions are tracked.
pain_point: WhatsApp messages are disconnected from the OHC ecosystem, causing missed leads, untracked deposits, and fragmented customer history, breaking the 'One Assistant' promise.
use_case: Owner/operator personas (Maya the Home Baker and Fatima the Food Cart Operator) rely on direct messages to capture demand, confirm orders, and coordinate pickups. They need to manage WhatsApp conversations inside OHC without switching to their personal/business WhatsApp app.

title: Hive agent advisory mode findings collection
description: The discussion describes a workflow for Hive agents at lower ACMM levels to post advisory findings in a living issue, without creating issues or PRs. It is a process documentation rather than an explicit user demand for a tool feature.
pain_point: No explicit pain points expressed; the process is described as intended functionality. However, users may find it unclear how to distinguish advisory-only agents from those that can open issues/PRs.
use_case: Developers or system operators managing Hive agents need a centralized issue to collect and review advisory findings from agents operating in advisory mode, with periodic digest comments from a governor.

title: 将Skill使用遥测转换为隐私安全版本化模式
description: 用户需要将当前存储原始args的Skill使用日志系统改为只存储最小必要信息的版本化模式，避免收集不必要的个人数据，同时保留遥测功能。
pain_point: 当前hook存储了不必要的自由格式`args`，不仅包含多余payload，还未能提供区分host关闭和真实零调用的健康信号，且存在隐私风险。
use_case: 在Claude系统中，需要安全地收集技能使用日志以判断使用量，同时不存储用户、repo、args、prompt等隐私字段，改为只记录schema_version, event_type, ts, runtime, skill, session_key（基于本地随机key的哈希）。

title: run-da native fan-out lifecycle을 capability 기반으로 전환
description: Direct Codex의 문서화된 agent lifecycle(spawn_agent→wait_agent→close_agent, 6 threads)이 실제 codex-cli 0.144.1의 live surface(spawn_agent, send_message, followup_task, wait_agent, interrupt_agent, list_agents, no explicit close, 4 active slots)와 불일치하여 문서대로 실행 시 실패합니다. 이를 해결하기 위해 runtime mapping을 유지하되, 현재 tool availability와 advertised slot에 따라 current/legacy profile을 동적으로 선택하고, CLI-default probe와 active Desktop session의 model-visible surface 확인을 구분하는 capability 기반 lifecycle/slot 계약으로 전환해야 합니다.
pain_point: 문서가 전제한 close_agent가 없고 root 포함 동시 slot도 문서의 고정값과 다르며, FULL reviewer 4개를 한 batch로 띄우거나 없는 close를 호출하면 문서대로 실행한 것이 실패함. runtime mapping이 실제와 불일치하여 거짓 안전을 만들고 개발자 작업을 중단시킴.
use_case: 개발자가 Direct Codex를 사용하여 multi-agent system을 실행할 때, 문서에 명시된 agent lifecycle(spawn_agent→wait_agent→close_agent, 6 threads)을 따르지만 실제 CLI surface(spawn_agent, send_message, followup_task, wait_agent, interrupt_agent, list_agents, no close, 4 active slots)와 달라서 agent 생성 및 종료가 제대로 동작하지 않고 실패함. 문서와 실제 surface 간의 불일치로 인해 reviewer를 batch로 띄우거나 close를 호출할 수 없는 문제가 발생.

title: Replace boolean tool outcomes with native error semantics
description: Replace the boolean 'ok' discriminator in KhalaToolResult with an explicit success-or-coded-error union, eliminating the duplication of success state and the misrepresentation of validation failures as successes. The new contract uses a closed union of success { summary, data? } and failure { summary, error } with stable error codes like 'invalid_issue_packet', and callers narrow by the error field.
pain_point: The current boolean 'ok' discriminator treats validation failure (e.g., partial or mixed-schema packets) as a successful tool execution, only distinguishable through data.valid: false. This duplicates success state, treats failure as success, and adds visual burden in Pi rendering (pretty-printed result JSON), making it difficult to quickly discern actual errors from successful validations.
use_case: Developers using Khala runtime tools (e.g., khala_triage.validate) currently receive a KhalaToolResult with a boolean 'ok' field, where a validation failure (partial, empty, or mixed-schema issue) is reported as success (ok: true) but with data.valid: false. In Pi, this renders as a compact JSON string with duplicated success state, making the collapsed output non-native and hard to interpret. The desired use case is to have a concise, native success/error presentation in Pi while preserving structured data for expanded, session, and model-visible contexts.

pain_point: Advisory agents cannot automatically create issues or PRs from analysis, requiring manual follow-up.
use_case: Advisory agents analyzing code and posting findings in a GitHub issue without creating issues or PRs.

title: Reuse ai-sdk types directly and align VoltAgent API with ai-sdk v7
description: Make VoltAgent an outer framework around ai-sdk instead of a hidden abstraction layer. The primary API should reuse ai-sdk names, options, semantics, and types. VoltAgent-specific features must live under a `voltagent` namespace. This solves semantic drift, duplicated types, and blocked access to newer ai-sdk capabilities.
pain_point: Current `agent.generateText(input, options)` is positional not object-style; `BaseGenerationOptions` is hand-written and extends `Partial<CallSettings>`; `maxSteps`, `stop`, `context`, `UsageInfo`, `Tool`, `LLMProvider` create parallel concepts; `@voltagent/core` peers `ai:^6.0.0` while current ai-sdk source is v7, blocking access to new capabilities.
use_case: VoltAgent developer wants to use ai-sdk v7's generateText, tool, Output APIs directly without duplicating types or losing access to new features. They propose an object-style API `agent.generateText({ prompt, temperature, voltagent: {...} })` and an escape hatch `agent.run(...)` for raw ai-sdk calls.

title: 自动化OpenAPI规范生成以消除文档漂移
description: 用户通过手动审计发现了大量OpenAPI规范与API实现之间的差距，希望项目能在CI/CD流水线中自动生成OAS规范，确保文档始终与当前发布版本一致，减少手动维护工作。
pain_point: 手动审计OpenAPI规范与API实现之间的差距非常耗时且容易遗漏，导致文档长期落后于实际功能，影响开发者接入和第三方工具集成。缺乏自动化验证手段，每次API变更都需要额外人工检查规范是否更新。
use_case: 在Directus项目中，开发者需要确保OpenAPI规范文件（@directus/specs）与实际REST API（@directus/api）完全同步。目前通过人工对比控制器路由和规范路径，发现了大量未文档化路径、错误方法和参数，希望未来能通过自动化流水线在构建/发布时生成OAS规范，自动检测并修复漂移。

title: mockforge生成k6脚本时变量名含点导致语法错误
description: 用户使用mockforge v0.3.2生成k6脚本时，脚本中变量名包含点号（如Unexpected token .），导致k6执行失败。用户期望mockforge能生成正确、无语法错误的k6 JavaScript脚本，兼容所有OpenAPI规范。
pain_point: mockforge创建的k6 JavaScript脚本包含点号作为变量名的字符，JavaScript不识别，导致k6运行失败并抛出错误：'Line 6:12 Unexpected token . (and 19 more errors)'。
use_case: 用户运行命令：mockforge bench --spec billing_subscriptions_v1.json --target https://<any_server> --scenario constant --vus 50，期望生成可执行的k6脚本来进行性能测试。

title: Automated Required Status Checks Configuration
description: The team needs AI or automated tooling to configure required status checks across multiple repositories, as the current manual admin action (via GitHub UI or gh CLI) is blocking the E2E robustness gate.
pain_point: Manual step to enable required status checks is the only blocker; PRs can merge even when E2E fails, risking integration bugs.
use_case: Setting branch protection rules to require E2E workflow checks before PRs can merge, as documented in C6 of the E2E robustness epic.

title: Acompanhamento baseado em evidências de misses de skills Praxis
description: Necessidade de registrar e acompanhar sistematicamente as lacunas reais de skills identificadas durante implementações, auditorias e migrações usando Praxis, evitando a criação desnecessária de novas skills e garantindo que as correções sejam baseadas em evidências concretas.
pain_point: Falta de um processo sistemático para capturar evidências de misses de skills, como uma skill rotear para o dono canônico errado, permitir fechamento com validação fraca, recomendar adaptação local quando a solução correta é contrato/plataforma, estar desatualizada em relação a artefatos públicos, ou quando uma tarefa recorrente exige conhecimento canônico ainda não codificado.
use_case: Acompanhar a próxima fase do programa de skills Praxis após a reconciliação do manifesto com 161 skills Praxis ativas, registrando apenas evidências reais encontradas durante implementações, auditorias e migrações usando Praxis.
